sections.title: Test launcher steps
sections.what: Checks a test file was given, enters the backend folder to turn on its Python environment, runs the Excel test runner with the chosen collection, and points to the results folder.
sections.why: Saves repeating the setup and arguments for every test run.
sections.watch_out: A missing virtual environment produces a raw shell error rather than a helpful message.

summary: A short launcher that runs the Excel test runner with a test file and a collection name.
purpose: Lets a tester run the question tests with one command.
why: Saves typing the environment setup and arguments each time.
how: Stops with usage help if no test file is given. Otherwise it sets the collection to default if none is given, enters the backend folder, turns on its virtual environment, returns to the top folder, and runs the test runner with the test file and collection. It then reports where results are saved.
inputs: A path to an Excel test file, and an optional collection name.
outputs: Console output from the test runner, and reports in the test_results folder.
risks: If the virtual environment named venv is missing, the script stops with a raw shell error. Results are written to test_results only if the runner completes.
debug: If it stops at activation, create the backend virtual environment. If the test file is not found, check the path relative to the folder you ran the script from. The success message appears even if individual tests failed.
